en_title: The Last of Us Day Reveals Ghost of Yotei Collab Content and Ambience Video as Fans Beg Naughty Dog for TLOU 3
cn_title: 《羊蹄山之魂》顽皮狗公布《最后生还者》日联动内容
subtitle: 第三部仍无消息
opus_summary: 顽皮狗公布2026年《最后生还者》日活动内容：《羊蹄山之魂》将推出循声者主题护甲，PlayStation和Steam将上线主题头像，另有一小时氛围视频。粉丝期待的第三部仍无消息。

paragraphs.en: Naughty Dog has revealed that it's celebrating The Last of Us Day 2026 with Ghost of Yotei content, player avatars on PlayStation and Steam, and an hour-long ambience video as fans continue begging for any updates on The Last of Us Part 3.
paragraphs.cn: 顽皮狗公布了2026年《最后生还者》日的活动内容，包括《羊蹄山之魂》联动内容、PlayStation和Steam平台的玩家头像，以及一段一小时的氛围视频。粉丝仍在盼望《最后生还者》第三部的任何消息。

paragraphs.en: It's… probably not what you or anyone else was expecting to see when the Sony studio teased plans for its annual holiday over the weekend . Instead of confirmation for The Last of Us Part 3 (or even yet, another remaster of an existing title), Naughty Dog instead revealed a collection of smaller surprises to keep fans tied over.
paragraphs.cn: 这恐怕不是索尼旗下的顽皮狗上周末预告年度活动安排时，大家期待看到的内容。顽皮狗没有确认《最后生还者》第三部，甚至也没公布现有作品的新复刻版，而是拿出了一系列小惊喜，让粉丝暂时有些东西可期待。

paragraphs.en: The headline is no doubt an armor set that's coming to Sucker Punch Productions' Ghost of Yotei. Available starting October 1, players will be able to hop into the sequel's Most Wanted mode while sporting Clicker-inspired armor. After it's unlocked, players will be able to use it in the base game, as well as its new Echoes of Sekigahara DLC. You can see a first look at The Last of Us armor below.
paragraphs.cn: 其中最引人注目的无疑是Sucker Punch Productions旗下《羊蹄山之魂》即将推出的一套护甲。10月1日起，玩家可以穿上以循声者为灵感设计的护甲，游玩这款续作的「最高通缉」模式。解锁后，玩家也能在游戏本体和新DLC《关原回响》中使用这套护甲。下方可以看到这套《最后生还者》护甲的首次展示。

paragraphs.en: So, what else is there for The Last of Us Day 2026? Naughty Dog also announced a partnership with collectible company Youtooz for a Bloody Clicker figure. In addition to the previously revealed Welcome Hub background wallpaper for PS5, PlayStation users can enjoy four new themed avatars, with even more available on PC via Steam.
paragraphs.cn: 2026年《最后生还者》日还有什么内容？顽皮狗还宣布与收藏品公司Youtooz合作，推出一款血腥循声者手办。除了此前公布的PS5欢迎中心背景壁纸，PlayStation用户还能获得四款新的主题头像；PC玩家则可以通过Steam获得更多头像。

paragraphs.en: Also starting October 1 at 10 AM PDT / 1 PM EDT is a new Steam and Epic Games Store sale, which will discount The Last of Us Part 1 by 50% and The Last of Us Part 2 by 33%. There's also a new hour-long subway ambiance video for those who miss living in the series' Cordyceps-infested world. Does any of this come with a tease for The Last of Us Part 3? Well, no. Not at all.
paragraphs.cn: Steam和Epic Games Store还将在10月1日太平洋夏令时间上午10点／东部夏令时间下午1点（北京时间10月2日凌晨1点）开启促销：《最后生还者》第一部打五折，第二部降价33%。对于想念系列中那个被虫草菌侵蚀的世界的玩家，顽皮狗还准备了一段一小时的地铁氛围视频。这些内容里有没有《最后生还者》第三部的预告？没有，一点也没有。

paragraphs.en: It's been more than six years since Naughty Dog released The Last of Us Part 2, the series' latest entry. While the time between has seen the launch of important installments in the groundbreaking post-apocalyptic franchise, including the launch of two seasons for its live-action HBO adaptation , it's also brought disappointment for fans.
paragraphs.cn: 距离顽皮狗推出系列最新一作《最后生还者》第二部，已经过去六年多。这段时间里，这个颇具开创性的末日题材系列仍有重要新内容问世，包括HBO真人改编剧集播出的两季，但粉丝也经历了失望。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps the biggest blow to those hoping to hear more about where the franchise is heading was the cancellation of the long-in-development multiplayer spinoff , which many referred to as The Last of Us Online . Sony officially pulled the plug in December 2023, with Naughty Dog team promising it would focus solely on single-player games going forward.
paragraphs.cn: 对那些希望了解系列未来走向的粉丝来说，打击最大的或许是开发已久的多人游戏衍生作被取消。许多人称这款游戏为《The Last of Us Online》。索尼于2023年12月正式叫停该项目，顽皮狗团队则承诺今后专注于单人游戏。

paragraphs.en: As The Last of Us Part 3 remains absent and without any official confirmation that it's even in development, the studio is still very much in the weeds of its next new IP, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet . Initial footage for the project seemed promising when it was shown off in 2024 , but two years later, we still know little about it, too.
paragraphs.cn: 《最后生还者》第三部依然没有现身，官方甚至尚未确认它是否正在开发。与此同时，顽皮狗仍在忙于打造下一个全新IP《星际：异端先知》。这款游戏于2024年亮相时，首批画面看起来颇有潜力，但两年过去，我们对它同样所知不多。

paragraphs.en: In addition to all of today's aforementioned goodies and a No Return charity stream for AbleGamers, the studio also announced it has established dedicated The Last of Us social media pages across Instagram , Facebook , and X/Twitter . Still, fans spent the days leading up to The Last of Us Day hoping the holiday would come with any news about the future of the series. Some hoped it might come with confirmation that The Last of Us Part 3 was in the works at all, but for now, at least, it seems fans will have to wait.
paragraphs.cn: 除了上述活动内容，以及为AbleGamers举办的「不归路」慈善直播，顽皮狗还宣布在Instagram、Facebook和X开设了《最后生还者》专属账号。不过，在《最后生还者》日到来前的几天里，粉丝一直盼着听到系列未来的消息。有些人希望顽皮狗至少能确认第三部正在开发，但眼下看来，粉丝还得继续等。

paragraphs.en: The future of The Last of Us continues to be a mystery as Naughty Dog celebrates The Last of Us Day 2026. In the meantime, you can see why some fans think a tease from Neil Druckmann suggests a third game will happen eventually . You can also read up on the multiplayer mod canceled at Sony's request earlier this month, and the new cast members that joined the show's third season .
paragraphs.cn: 顽皮狗庆祝2026年《最后生还者》日之际，系列未来仍是个谜。有些粉丝认为，Neil Druckmann此前的一番暗示表明第三部终有一天会推出。本月早些时候，一款多人游戏模组应索尼要求被取消；《最后生还者》剧集第三季也有新演员加入。
